mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that leads to reduced corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
